websiteA_3D.whySelected: AETHERION Calibre Zero offers the highest cinematic 3D potential (99/100) and visual originality (98/100) without requiring external desktop apps. Its triaxial tourbillon gimbal rings, refractive sapphire dome, 48-tooth escapement wheel, meteorite dial sectors, and glowing tritium indices translate naturally into a 14-part articulated React Three Fiber assembly that smoothly explodes and re-engages as the user scrolls forward and backward.

websiteB_Non3D.whySelected: KUROKAWA & VANE represents the pinnacle of non-WebGL editorial web design (Design Quality 98/100, Performance 98/100). Grounded in cleaved volcanic basalt, travertine stone, and Swiss-Japanese architectural typography, it showcases asymmetric exposed-hairline grids, interactive blueprint elevation switchers, tactile material acoustics, and serene Motion choreography—completely distinct in industry, tone, and technical stack from Website A.

ideas.concept: An independent Geneva-Tokyo horological laboratory engineering 'Calibre Zero'—a zero-gravity triaxial tourbillon and sidereal astrolabe chronograph machined from grade-5 brushed titanium, Muonionalusta meteorite slate, and domed optical sapphire.
ideas.targetAudience: Horological collectors, mechanical engineering patrons, industrial design connoisseurs, and sovereign museum curators.
ideas.visualIdentity: Obsidian horological slate (#07090D), brushed grade-5 titanium (#94A3B8), phosphor tritium amber (#F59E0B), and cryogenic sapphire cyan (#38BDF8). Paired with Syne Display, Plus Jakarta Sans, and JetBrains Mono telemetry.
ideas.heroComposition: Full-viewport 3D stage with the suspended Calibre Zero triaxial tourbillon positioned slightly right-of-center, framed by a precision perimeter HUD, live sidereal frequency counter (28,800 vph / 4 Hz), and monumental bottom-left display typography.
ideas.animationConcept: Bidirectional GSAP ScrollTrigger timeline scrubbing through 5 horological chapters: (01) Monolithic Exterior Assembly, (02) Triaxial Gimbal Kinematics, (03) Exploded Escapement & Meteorite Bridges, (04) Sidereal Sapphire Optics, and (05) Bespoke Allocation Vault.
ideas.threeDOpportunities: 14-part procedural React Three Fiber assembly featuring 3 counter-rotating gimbal cages, instanced 48-tooth escapement gear rings, refractive sapphire crystal dome (MeshPhysicalMaterial transmission), balance spring helix, and interactive exploded-view separation.
ideas.referenceImageDirection: Macro studio photography of an avant-garde titanium triaxial tourbillon watch mechanism floating in dark obsidian space, dramatic warm amber rim lighting against cool sapphire crystal reflections, minimal Swiss technical HUD typography overlay.
ideas.implementationFeasibility: 100% self-contained in Three.js + R3F + Drei using parametric Torus, Cylinder, Lathe, and InstancedMesh assemblies plus studio Lightformers—zero external Blender/Spline dependency.
